scope: Exactly three PDF-verified claim-level evidence records for the NeuroTrace hackathon MVP.

records.title: Metaphor processing is influenced by stimulus emotionality and task demands: Evidence from ERPs
records.pdf_file_name: Baiocco - 2025 - Metaphor processing is influenced by stimulus emotionality and task demands Evidence from ERPs.pdf
records.scope: 英语母语者；情绪/中性、隐喻/字面句；意义合理性判断与被动阅读两种任务。
records.finding: 意义合理性判断中，情绪隐喻相对情绪字面句出现 N400（300–450 ms）和左前 LN（450–850 ms）；被动阅读中出现更正的 LP（450–850 ms）。任务要求与刺激情绪性共同决定 ERP 模式。
records.claim_boundary: 只能证明任务和情绪性会改变隐喻 ERP；不可作为“支持性语境降低 N400”的直接证据。
records.conditions: emotional/neutral × metaphorical/literal; sensicality judgement vs passive reading
records.effect_direction: task- and emotionality-dependent; no supportive-context direction tested

records.title: Context-modulating effect on processing scientific metaphors: Evidence from ERPs
records.pdf_file_name: Tang 等 - 2025 - Context-modulating effect on processing scientific metaphors Evidence from ERPs.pdf
records.scope: 科学隐喻；功能相似型 SMF 与形状相似型 SMS；无语境、相关语境、无关语境。
records.finding: 相关语境总体降低科学隐喻加工难度；无关语境产生干扰；效应随 SMF/SMS 类型及早期语义提取、后期重分析阶段而不同。
records.claim_boundary: 不能泛化为所有语境、所有隐喻类型都稳定降低 N400。
records.conditions: context-free vs relevant context vs irrelevant context; SMF vs SMS
records.effect_direction: relevant context can facilitate; irrelevant context can interfere; type/stage dependent

records.title: Dynamic effect of context on processing L2 metaphors with varied conventionality: An ERP study
records.pdf_file_name: Yao 等 - 2025 - Dynamic effect of context on processing L2 metaphors with varied conventionality An ERP study.pdf
records.scope: 中国英语双语者；L2 常规/新颖隐喻；支持性/字面语境；句子分为三个加工片段。
records.finding: 常规隐喻在两种语境下的 N400、持续负波和晚期正波无显著差异；新颖隐喻在支持性语境中早期持续负波/N400 更大，晚期额前正波更小，即早期阻碍词汇通达、后期促进整合。
records.claim_boundary: 直接否定“跨隐喻类型稳定降低 N400”。
records.conditions: L2 conventional/novel metaphor × supportive/literal context across three sentence segments
records.effect_direction: conventional: null context effect; novel: early inhibition, later facilitation
